modern: It is not right that I should give myself pain, for I have never intentionally given pain even to another.
original: It is not fit that I should give myself pain, for I have never intentionally given pain even to another.

explained.summary: Marcus has never deliberately hurt anyone else, so it makes no sense for him to hurt himself. It’s a gentle note against self-torment: the kindness you’d show others is owed to yourself too.
explained.today: Replaying an embarrassing comment for days, or calling yourself names over a small mistake, is treatment you’d never give a friend. Marcus suggests you don’t give it to yourself either.
